phrases-50-38-six-days-creation-and-no-w.title: Creating the World in Six Days and 'No Weariness Touched Us'
phrases-50-38-six-days-creation-and-no-w.note: Surah 50:38 states that God created the heavens and earth in six days and adds 'No weariness touched Us in doing that,' matching Bereishit Rabbah 10:9 ('It was not with toil and not with exertion that the Holy One created His world') and Isaiah 40:28.

discussion.view: al-Ṭabarī and Ibn Kathīr report that Surah 50:38 was revealed to refute a Jewish claim that God rested on the seventh day to recover from fatigue.
discussion.reply: While Genesis 2:2 and Exodus 31:17 state that God 'ceased and rested' on the seventh day, neither the Hebrew Bible nor rabbinic tradition teaches that God experienced fatigue: Isaiah 40:28 explicitly states that the Creator 'shall not hunger, nor be weary,' and Bereishit Rabbah 10:9 explains Genesis 2:2 in the exact terms echoed by Surah 50:38 ('It was not with toil and not with exertion that the Holy One blessed be He created His world').

phrases-50-38-six-days-creation-and-no-w.quranEn: Certainly We created the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, in six days. No weariness touched Us in (doing) that.
quranHighlights: We created the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, in six days. No weariness touched Us in (doing) that.

sources.title: Midrash Bereishit Rabbah (Creation Without Toil or Exertion)
sources.workSub: Midrash Bereishit Rabbah (Creation Without Toil or Exertion)
sources.en: “His labor” – did Rabbi Berekhya not say this in the name of Rabbi Simon: It was not with toil and not with exertion that the Holy One blessed be He created His world.
highlights: It was not with toil and not with exertion that the Holy One blessed be He created His world.
sources.orig: מְלַאכְתּוֹ, לֹא כֵן אָמַר רַבִּי בֶּרֶכְיָה בְּשֵׁם רַבִּי סִימוֹן, לֹא בְּעָמָל וְלֹא בִּיגִיעָה בָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶת עוֹלָמוֹ, וְאַתְּ אוֹמֵר מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ, אֶתְמְהָה.

sources.title: Septuagint (LXX) - Isaiah
sources.en: And now, have you not known? have you not heard? the eternal God, the God that formed the ends of the earth, shall not hunger, nor be weary, and there is no searching of his understanding.
highlights: the eternal God, the God that formed the ends of the earth, shall not hunger, nor be weary
